provider_transport.intent: Provider protocol compatibility, HTTP/API transport, SDK adaptation and retry/fallback plumbing should reuse mature provider libraries. XiaoYu may retain per-attempt privacy, freshness and fallback authority.

memory_retrieval.intent: Lexical search, embeddings, vector search, reranking and memory extraction/classification should reuse mature components. XiaoYu retains truth, admissibility, erasure and audience authority.

resource_runtime.intent: Host telemetry and device inspection should reuse mature OS/vendor libraries. XiaoYu retains resource policy, lease semantics and preemption decisions.

vision_runtime.intent: Screen capture and high-rate capture should reuse mature capture libraries. XiaoYu retains privacy, TTL, change-selection and observation authority.

voice_runtime.intent: Audio pipeline, VAD, ASR and TTS orchestration should reuse mature voice components. XiaoYu retains semantic turn, interruption and canonical-event boundaries.

observability.intent: Tracing, metrics and export plumbing should reuse OpenTelemetry-compatible components. XiaoYu retains privacy-safe allowlists and Guardian findings.

credentials.intent: Secret storage should reuse the host credential store/keyring. XiaoYu must not implement a new secret vault.

external_tool_runtime.intent: External tool protocols, long-running task polling and sandbox execution should reuse MCP/standard sandbox runtimes where available. XiaoYu retains authorization and effect semantics.

release_distribution.intent: Artifact signing, update metadata and secure distribution should reuse mature supply-chain standards rather than custom cryptographic/update protocols.
